lines.text: A GTA 6 player found a man who thinks the whole world is a video game.
There's a hidden hideout in Belville. Fact! Two outlets reported it, found by a fan on launch day.
Notes inside show someone sure he's living in a game.
He spots identical NPCs, and locked doors with nothing behind them.
Rockstar confirmed it. Myth! The studio hasn't said a word.
Clever writing, or something stranger? Comment which!
